name: St. Regis Cap Cana

address.street: The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort

insider_take: Where Caribbean luxury meets impeccable service - this is paradise with a St. Regis signature touch.
whats_special: The St. Regis Cap Cana sits on the exclusive Cap Cana marina, home to the Caribbean's largest mega-yacht marina. The resort features the region's only Jack Nicklaus Signature Punta Espada Golf Course, consistently ranked among the Caribbean's top courses. Each suite comes with personalized St. Regis Butler Service, a tradition dating back to 1904.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing the Punta Espada Golf Course for stunning sunrise views over the fairways and Caribbean Sea - it's the same vista that's made this course a favorite filming location for luxury travel campaigns.
dont_miss: The nightly St. Regis sabering ritual at sunset, where champagne is opened with a ceremonial saber. Also explore nearby Juanillo Beach, consistently rated among the world's most beautiful beaches, and the Cap Cana Heritage School where you can learn about local Dominican culture and crafts.
pros: Legendary St. Regis Butler Service with 24/7 personalized assistance
Pristine beachfront location on Cap Cana's exclusive coastline
Championship Jack Nicklaus Signature golf course on-site
Luxurious suites with private terraces and ocean views
cons: Secluded location may require transportation for off-resort dining
